cards.card_text: Under His feet is a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
cards.verse_text: Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
cards.snippet: Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.

cards.card_text: Sapphires with flecks of gold Pearls from the deep sea Jasper and emerald stones
cards.verse_text: Its rocks are the source of sapphires, containing flecks of gold.
cards.snippet: Its rocks are the source of sapphires, containing flecks of gold.

cards.card_text: People can dig silver, gold and sapphires out of the dark, 'But where can wisdom be found, and where does understanding dwell?'
cards.verse_text: Its rocks are the source of sapphires, containing flecks of gold.
cards.snippet: Its rocks are the source of sapphires, containing flecks of gold.

cards.card_text: Then Job lines up the finest treasures on earth next to wisdom: gold of Ophir, onyx, sapphire, crystal, coral, quartz, rubies and topaz from Cush.
cards.verse_text: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or sapphire.
cards.snippet: …cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or sapphire.

cards.card_text: Stones set in antimony, foundations of sapphires, pinnacles of rubies, gates of sparkling jewels.
cards.verse_text: “O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.
cards.snippet: …I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.

cards.card_text: Above that expanse is the likeness of a ___ with the appearance of sapphire.
cards.verse_text: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.
cards.snippet: …their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of…

cards.card_text: A man clothed in linen, sent with a writing kit to mark everyone sighing and groaning over the city's abominations, has just reported back: "I have done as You commanded." (Ezekiel 9:2-4, 11) Now Ezekiel looks up, and above the heads of the cherubim he sees the likeness of a throne of sapphire.
cards.verse_text: And I looked and saw above the expanse, above the heads of the cherubim, the likeness of a throne of sapphire.
cards.snippet: …above the heads of the cherubim, the likeness of a throne of sapphire.

cards.card_text: The riders in John's vision have breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire and sulfur.
cards.verse_text: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur.
cards.snippet: …vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur.
